payload.reason: The evidence provides specific criteria for selecting the top 10 nonsynonymous mutations based on their frequency and biological impact, including co-mutation analysis and functional predictions.

claims.text: The top 10 nonsynonymous mutations were selected based on their frequency in 30,229 SARS-CoV-2 genome sequences and their predicted biological impact.
Co-mutation analysis was used to assess the interaction and evolutionary relationship between the top 10 nonsynonymous mutations.
The mutations were identified as having high concurrence ratios, indicating they may evolve together and interact functionally.
